correctness.rationale: The factor identity gives the line-bundle relation \(A^{\otimes2}\simeq B^{\otimes2}\); the incidence bundle is then trivial. Exact arithmetic in \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt5)\) verifies \(j=24918016/45\).
